draft.subject: Edge AI perception on Jetson, Robotics Systems Engineer
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas and I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I came across LuminX's Robotics Systems Engineer role and wanted to reach out to you as the technical co founder, since what you are building is close to what I have spent the last couple of years building myself.

I put vision models on NVIDIA Jetson using TensorRT so they run fast in real time, stood up a multi camera capture pipeline, and got a robot picking parts reliably by working through the failures where software meets hardware, things like servo brown outs and stale camera frames. I have also driven a microcontroller from a Jetson over serial and worked hands on with sensors, wiring, and hardware bring up.

Running perception on edge cameras out in real warehouses is exactly the problem I want to work on. Would you be open to a short conversation?
draft.hook_used: Domain relevance: technical co-founder building the exact edge-camera perception systems Justin has built
